edits.rationale: Mongoid's auto_embed_field takes a quantization argument and copies it into the autoEmbed field spec. DRIVERS-3389 asks drivers for builder and type support so autoEmbed vector search indexes can set quantization and numDimensions. The ticket's linked driver tickets (Java, C#, PHP, Mongoid and others) cover that work.
